entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane that was split into five shards and is reunited by the Maelstrom in this set.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: The shard of Alara ruled by sigils and order, home of aven, rhoxes and knights; invaded by outsiders.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The shard of Alara of etherium-wielding mages, alchemists and artificers.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The shard of Alara of necromancers and demons, where no one dies of old age.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The savage shard of Alara of dragons, tar pits and predators.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The jungle shard of Alara of elves, nacatl and titanic behemoths.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: The vortex into which the shards of Alara merge, spawning new monstrosities such as the Child of Alara.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker whose world-bending machinations are about to triumph at the conflux.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The merging of the five shards of Alara back into one world, engineered by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-revering planeswalker for whom the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A champion of Bant who values knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins as a weapon.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin who quotes the teaching of Marisi that instinct is all a warrior needs.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: A teacher of Ajani who taught that instinct is the only thing a true warrior needs.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: An elf leader of Naya who finds herself general of Naya's mightiest army.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer who praises the aether-lich as crafted perfection.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A Bant knight who praises wild leotau as mounts.

entities.name: Taric
entities.description: A Bant man who receives new wings and heavenly resolve through Asha's Favor.

entities.name: Galo Aher
entities.description: A paragon of honor of Bant who fell to a blast of fire and was honored with a new sigil.

entities.name: Order of the White Orchid
entities.description: A Bant order that forged a new sigil in Galo Aher's likeness.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: An angelic protector who left Bant, ensuring protection and order in her absence.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A Hydra-god of Alara whose return brings the Ancient Ziggurat back.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon-dragon, untrustworthy and unruled; its cup taints drinkers with hunger and lies.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A Jund leader called a pawn with pawns of his own by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Sedris, the Traitor King
entities.description: A Grixis king who says the meek inherit nothing.

entities.name: Niclavs
entities.description: An Esper archmage who exults in the potency of the cumber stone.

entities.name: Egbol
entities.description: A goblin awed by the abundant food and loot of Naya.

entities.name: Tiyan
entities.description: A nacatl whose survival in Naya prepared her for the civilized battles of Bant.

entities.name: Niella
entities.description: A Valeron outlander who honed her philosophy debating rhoxes.

entities.name: Togk Manytooth
entities.description: A warrior immobilized helplessly while kathari circle above.

entities.name: Knights of the Reliquary
entities.description: Bant knights who crusade to recover lost treasures from Esper.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: Esper vedalken searching for the red stone that could reforge Esper.

entities.name: Ancient Ziggurat
entities.description: A temple built in honor of Alara's creatures that reappeared when Progenitus awakened.

events.summary: Taric is lifted on new wings above Bant and finds earthly aspirations turned into heavenly resolve.
events.quote: As his new wings lifted him high above Bant, Taric felt his earthly aspirations transform into heavenly resolve.

events.summary: Galo Aher falls to a blast of fire and the Order of the White Orchid forges a sigil in his likeness.
events.quote: A paragon of honor, Galo Aher fell to a blast of fire.

events.summary: The nations of Bant forget their war and unite against a common threat.
events.quote: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

events.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring protection and order in her absence.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Outsiders invade Bant and its soldiers learn to value battle scars as much as sigils.
events.quote: As the outsiders invaded Bant, soldiers who once saw sigils as the highest marks of glory began to see the scars of battle as tokens of equal worth.

events.summary: Togk Manytooth is held helpless while kathari circle overhead.
events.quote: Togk Manytooth struggled helplessly as the kathari circled above him.

events.summary: A parasitic strix, finding no food on Grixis's edges, turns to the skies of Bant.
events.quote: After finding no sustenance on the edges of Grixis, it turned to the skies of Bant.

events.summary: The bones of Jund's dead resurface in Naya, poisoning the jungle and the sunseeders' crops.
events.quote: The bones of Jund's dead resurfaced in Naya, poisoning the jungle and killing the sunseeders' crops.

events.summary: As Grixis collides with the rest of Alara, the worlds begin to hear the whispers of the forgotten dead.
events.quote: As Grixis collided with the rest of Alara, the worlds began to hear the hateful whispers of the forgotten dead.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas remarks that the finest pawns have pawns of their own, of Rakka Mar.
events.quote: The finest pawns are those with pawns of their own.

events.summary: The shards complete their merging and Alara is whole again.
events.quote: Alara is broken no more.

events.summary: The conflux nears and Bolas's long machinations are about to triumph.
events.quote: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

events.summary: As the shards merge into the Maelstrom, their mana fuses into new monstrosities.
events.quote: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

events.summary: Egbol stares in wonder at Naya's landscape, seeing only things to eat and steal.
events.quote: Egbol stared in wonder at Naya's landscape.

events.summary: When the shards merge, Mayael finds herself general of Naya's mightiest army.
events.quote: When the shards merged, Mayael found herself the general of Naya's mightiest army.

events.summary: Progenitus, the Soul of the World, returns.
events.quote: The Soul of the World has returned.

events.summary: Plowbeasts of Naya escape their harnesses and feed on the fields of Eos and Valeron.
events.quote: Plowbeasts of Naya escaped their harnesses in droves

events.summary: Esper thieves find it easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.
events.quote: thieves from Esper found it surprisingly easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.

events.summary: The Seekers of Carmot search the unknown lands for the red stone that could reforge Esper.
events.quote: The Seekers of Carmot searched across the unknown lands

events.summary: The dead of Grixis catch the scent of life and follow it into Jund.
events.quote: The ripe smell of life drifted into Grixis.

events.summary: The Ancient Ziggurat reappears when Progenitus awakens.
events.quote: When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

events.summary: Aven scouts locate the Reliquary Tower in Esper and the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a crusade to recover their treasures.
events.quote: the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a righteous crusade to recover their lost treasures.

events.summary: Goblins go to sleep in Jund and wake in Grixis facing zombies.
events.quote: The goblins went to sleep in Jund and awoke in Grixis.

relations.note: She becomes general of Naya's mightiest army.
relations.quote: Mayael found herself the general of Naya's mightiest army.

relations.note: Bolas calls him one of the pawns of Bolas's scheme.
relations.quote: The finest pawns are those with pawns of their own.

relations.note: The Order honored the fallen Galo Aher with a new sigil.
relations.quote: The Order of the White Orchid was so saddened that they forged a new sigil in his likeness.
